title: osmanthus ilicifolius f. rotundifolius
intro: Osmanthus ilicifolius f. rotundifolius, commonly known as Dwarf Tea Olive, is a plant species within the Osmanthus genus, known for its fragrant flowers and dark green leaves. The health benefits of Osmanthus ilicifolius f. rotundifolius include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, potentially helping to alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which can aid in promoting relaxation and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Osmanthus ilicifolius f. rotundifolius include saponins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
